name: TNPCB Consent to Establish (CTE)
description: Pollution control consent for establishing automotive component manufacturing in Tamil Nadu.

required_documents: Project report with manufacturing process flow
Site plan showing effluent treatment arrangement
Land document and local body clearance
metadata.statutory_fee: Consent fee as per TNPCB schedule, based on capital investment
application_steps: Create an account on the TNPCB online consent management system
Submit the Consent to Establish application with the project report
Upload effluent characterisation and treatment plan
Pay the consent fee for your investment slab
Respond to any queries raised by the District Environmental Engineer
metadata.portal_name: TNPCB OCMMS Online Consent Management Portal

name: Factory License (Tamil Nadu)
description: Statutory factory license under Tamil Nadu Factories Rules for manufacturing premises.

required_documents: Site and building plan approved by the Inspectorate of Factories
List of manufacturing processes and machinery
Proof of ownership or lease of premises
Details of workers employed and shift schedule
metadata.statutory_fee: As per Schedule to the Tamil Nadu Factories Rules, based on worker count and connected power load
application_steps: Register on the Tamil Nadu Labour Department single-window portal
Submit Form 1 with the approved building plan and machinery list
Pay the statutory licence fee under the prescribed schedule
Attend premises inspection by the Inspector of Factories
Receive the factory licence and display it at the premises
metadata.portal_name: DISH Tamil Nadu Factory Licensing Portal
